title: Realm Opening · Entry Ceremony
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji publicly exposed the Demonic Path conspiracy, the three assassins were counter-killed instead, and the righteous sects were in an uproar—and all of this was merely the first piece he placed on his chessboard.

text.content: The sky shone bright; atop the ancient altar, nine golden pillars of light shot into the heavens, dyeing the entire firmament in mysterious yellow. The opening ceremony of the ancient realm "Tianji Pavilion" officially began. Elders from various sects arrived through the air, the banners of Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and White Tiger Sect fluttering dramatically in the clouds. Dozens of core disciples stood in formation on both sides, the atmosphere reaching an extreme solemnity.

Chen Ji stood among the core disciples, his blue Daoist robe swaying gently in the wind, his expression calm as still water. Yet the gazes around him were anything but calm—mockery, jealousy, suspicion, various emotions intertwined. What right does this废物 have to stand here? The Inner Disciples of Tianqing Sect whispered among themselves, their voices low yet clearly reaching Chen Ji's ears.

dialogue.content: (Smiling on the surface, cold laughing inside) Waste? Interesting. Wait and see, I'll show you who's the real废物.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew warm, that familiar stinging sensation spreading from his brow center. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice rang in his mind: "They're here. Northwest corner, three people, assassination target—the Grand Elder of Xuanwu Sect." Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, but his expression remained unchanged as he continued surveying his surroundings with that harmless look.

dialogue.content: "Act carefully. These three are death warriors from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, skilled at concealing their aura." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of gravity, "If you intervene directly, you may expose too much."

text.content: Chen Ji calculated quickly in his mind. Three Demonic Path death warriors assassinating the Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder—this scene was far more interesting than his own ridicule. The Tianji Record's vision appeared again: three black shadows burst from the crowd, poison needles pierced the air, the Grand Elder collapsed on the spot, blood splattering three feet. And he, Chen Ji, would be interrogated by all sects as a witness.

choice.prompt: The assassins are about to strike—time is running out! Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Block the poison needles with thunderous force, display strength to intimidate the entire crowd, but this will attract attention and investigation from all sects.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder's favor
choices.risk_hint: May attract Ling Yuan Old Master's attention

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flickered, and before the crowd could react, he had already swept into mid-air. With a wave of his sleeve, three cold gleams were brushed away; before the three death warriors could even cry out, they were sent flying several zhang by a burst of gentle force.

dialogue.content: (Slightly cupping his hands, face showing apology) The Grand Elder was startled. These individuals... seem to have been quite discourteous to you.

choices.text: Guide and explode the entire situation
choices.description: Lead the assassins to succeed in their assassination, use the opportunity to make Xuanwu Sect enmity with the Holy Sect of Demonic Path, reap the fisherman's benefit, but the Grand Elder may fall.
choices.visible_cost: The Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder may fall
choices.visible_reward: The Demonic Path and righteous path completely turn hostile, the alliance of sects collapses
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, the consequences would be unimaginable

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji's mouth lifted slightly as he deliberately stepped back, opening a passage. The three death warriors, seeing this, were overjoyed, thinking they had found the perfect assassination angle—all three burst forth—

dialogue.content: (Silently reciting in his heart) Go, let Xuanwu Sect know the might of the Demonic Path. This debt, we'll settle later.

choices.description: Remain motionless, expose after the assassins succeed, intervene as a "witness," maintain the废物 persona while controlling the situation.
choices.visible_reward: Gain trust from all sects as a witness
choices.risk_hint: If the Grand Elder dies from injuries, may be suspected as an accomplice

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, suppressing his aura to the lowest degree, perfectly playing the role of a傻了的废物 disciple. Three black shadows burst forth, poison needles pierced the air—the Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder grunted, his shoulder stained with blood.

dialogue.content: (Lowering his voice in shock) Assassins! People from the Demonic Path!

text.content: At this moment, a cold voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, completely different from Mo Xiansheng's aged tone—that was Ye Qing, the Holy Maiden of the Holy Sect of Demonic Path: "Chen Ji, I see your layout. The assassins are our people, but you wouldn't really let them succeed, would you?"

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Ye Qing's voice carried a playful tone, "Do you want to borrow a knife to kill, or play the hero to save the beauty? Tell me, I can help you—but of course, as exchange, you owe me a favor."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered. This Demonic Path Holy Maiden was indeed not simple. He thought rapidly—Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Mist" could conceal the Tianji Record's aura; if he could get her cooperation, this layout would be even more perfect. But cooperating with her was no different than making a pact with a tiger.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposes cooperation—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Team up with Ye Qing, use her Demonic Path Mist to conceal his movements, establish a preliminary trusting relationship.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Demonic Path Mist to conceal Tianji Record's aura
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is deep-minded, the favor will be hard to repay

dialogue.content: (Transmitting voice) Alright, I agree. But remember, your mist can only be used to conceal my aura—as for the assassination—let them handle it.
"Deal." Ye Qing's voice carried a smile, "You're much more interesting than I thought, Chen Ji."

choices.description: Decline Ye Qing's kindness, maintain independent action, owe no one from the Demonic Path any favors.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute independence, leave no leverage
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record's aura may be exposed

dialogue.content: (Transmitting voice) Not necessary. Chen Ji's chess game needs no outside interference.
"...Interesting." Ye Qing was silent for a moment, "Then I'll watch how this little fox escapes from this chess game."

text.content: The assassins' poison needles had already left their hands, three cold gleams heading directly for the Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder's face. In this critical moment, Chen Ji finally moved—he did not intercept directly, but in that split second, used his sleeve to sweep up a gust of wind, slightly deflecting the poison needles' trajectory.

dialogue.content: Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, bellowed: "What rats dare harm my sect's Elder!" He punched out, shattering one of the death warriors into a mist of blood. The other two death warriors, seeing the situation had turned against them, tried to retreat, but were blocked by several elders of Tianqing Sect who jointly sealed off their escape route.

text.content: The entire arena erupted in an uproar. Disciples from all sects were panicked, elders frantically deployed treasures to protect their own disciples. And Chen Ji, amid the chaos, quietly stepped back a few paces, reassuming that terrified废物 appearance. Only the corner of his mouth lifted into an almost imperceptible arc.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, frowned slightly, her gaze scanning the crowd before finally landing on Chen Ji. Her intuition told her that gust of wind had come too suspiciously—but when she tried to look more closely, the废物 had already shrunk into the depths of the crowd, his face harmless.

text.content: The two Demonic Path death warriors were captured alive, and under interrogation by elders of all sects, confessed their mastermind—the Holy Sect of Demonic Path. Although the Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder was injured, because of Chen Ji's sleeve deflection, the poison needle had not hit a vital spot. At this moment, his face was livid with anger as he discussed countermeasures with elders from Tianqing Sect and White Tiger Sect.

Chen Ji took advantage of the chaos to leave the crowd and found a secluded corner. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: "Well done. Deflecting the needles instead of intercepting directly—both saved the person and didn't attract attention—but Su Qingyao has already become suspicious."

dialogue.content: "No matter." Chen Ji said calmly, "Let her suspect. As long as there's no evidence, she'll forever be standing outside the door." His gaze passed over the crowd, landing on the faint shadowy figure in the distant clouds—that was Ye Qing, watching him with great interest.

text.content: The realm entrance slowly opened, and within the golden pillars of light, a majestic palace outline emerged. After discussion among elders of all sects, they decided: the entry ceremony would proceed as normal, but all sects must be doubly vigilant—the Demonic Path forces had clearly infiltrated. The Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder coldly snorted, personally leading the team into the realm, with Chen Ji following close behind.

The moment he stepped into the realm, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record violently shake. His heart tensed—he knew, there were indeed greater secrets hidden within. And what he was about to face might not only be the Demonic Path's conspiracy, but also the "Eye of Heavenly Dao" that gazed upon him from the unseen realms.
